description: This header file defines APIs for managing WiFi configuration objects within a data model, including functions to get and set string parameters for the managed WiFi configuration.

methods.name: Lanconfig_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified string parameter for the WiFi configuration object.

methods.name: Lanconfig_SetParamStringValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a specified string parameter for the WiFi configuration object.
